title: The Pot on Top
lines: I am Tom. A tin pot is on top.
I tap it. Tap, tap, tap.
Pop! The pot is not on top.
The pot is on the mat.
I mop it. Mop, mop, mop.
The mat is tan. The pot is on top.
I sit and sip. I nap.

questions.ask: What happened after Tom tapped the pot?
questions.listenFor: It went pop and it landed on the mat. Lines three and four tell it together, so let them read both.
Tom did, on his own. Listen for Tom and not a grown-up - that is the whole point of the story.

questions.ask: What went wrong in this story? Who put it right?
questions.listenFor: The pot popped off and landed on the mat, and Tom mopped it up himself. Lines three to five.
